en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a public square with palm trees, walking paths, and a decorative bandstand or gazebo on the right. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand and walk in the square, with arid mountains rising in the background. At the top is printed text in Portuguese identifying the location as a partial view of Praça Nova on the island of São Vicente, Cabo Verde.
